correctness.rationale: For all n>=1 an exact bijection maps half-graph matchings to set partitions of [n+1]. Under the graph involution this is literal order reversal. Invariant blocks form either a self-reversed block, a swapped pair of blocks with 2^(t-1) orientation assignments, or one central block; their arc-permutation signs and sizes are computed explicitly. The labelled exponential formula gives the all-n polynomial identities, and augmented Hopf trace plus Euler averaging gives the homological consequences. An independent exact matching enumeration and block recurrence agree on every signed coefficient through n=9. The infinite proof is combinatorial, not numerical.

Neither inspected statement calculates the reversal action on signed chains. The new theorem counts reversal-invariant partitions with orientation signs and determines all graded coefficients and quotient Euler numbers. Closest public-index hits address different graph families or different invariants. Residual risk: equivalent signed-partition enumeration in unindexed combinatorics.

value.rationale: The full signed cellular character on the natural order-reversing automorphism of an infinite family is a symmetry-sensitive invariant that ordinary Betti numbers or Stirling Euler sums cannot recover. It has a concise two-exponential form arising from the nontrivial distinction between self-reversed and exchanged partition blocks. The formula gives all reduced Lefschetz numbers and exact Euler characteristics of natural geometric quotients, including sizes where homology occurs in several degrees.
